Messages.Author: Pat
Messages.Body:
The new issue of Game Trade has a preview of about 6-7 cards from the new
set. I didn't bother to buy it, but here are a few things, to the best of my
memory:

- 9-cap Assamite
something inf-CEL-QUI-OBF-THA
Seraph, Black Hand
pays 1 less for QUI cards; pays 1 less for weapons; not blood cursed

- Potence strike
do not replace until (something happens - untap or combat ends I think)
pot +1 hand/+2 melee weapon
POT +2 hand/+3 melee

- Serpentis action, no cost
ser Tap a minion (maybe limited to prey?)
SER add a corruption counter, with text to take the minion if it's fully
corrupted (prey only? don't recall for sure)

- PA Card
requires indep vamp with capacity >=4
cost 2 blood
allocate 6 pool among 2 or more Meths

- Chimerstry action modifier
costs 1 (?)
chi cancel a reaction card that requires aus or dem
CHI +1 stealth, plus (burn a blood?) to use the chi effect as well

- Giovanni action; +1 stealth
put (foo) in play, or add a counter to a (foo) in play
add a counter whenever (a unique minion?) is burned; if the card has 7
counters or more, Giovanni all have NEC and can also take an action to put a
burned minion into play as a wraith with some wraith-like abilities

- Pat

sorry for the faulty memory

I know it's strong. But he has no one but the WoK embrace card to work
with. He would have been better off with Fort as then he'd fit in
better with Joe Boot, Janni and even Antara. All of which share Fort.

Kalinda who doesn't have Quietus or Parnasus who doesn't have Obs.

There are already 4 other gr 4 vampires with synergistic disciplines:

Hektor
Clan: Brujah antitribu (group 4)
Capacity: 9
Disciplines: CEL POT PRE QUI for
Sabbat priscus: Damage from Hektor's hand strikes is aggravated. Baali
get +1 bleed when bleeding you.

Rodrigo
Clan: Brujah antitribu (group 4)
Capacity: 5
Disciplines: CEL pot pre qui
Sabbat.

Kamiri wa Itherero
Clan: Akunanse (group 4)
Capacity: 10
Disciplines: ABO ANI FOR OBF pot qui
Laibon: Younger vampires must burn 1 blood to attempt to block Kamiri.
If an ally blocks Kamiri and combat occurs, burn the ally at the end
of the action.

Mukhtar Bey
Clan: Caitiff (group 4)
Capacity: 7
Disciplines: FOR PRE QUI obf pot
Camarilla Prince of Cairo: Mukhtar cannot use presses to continue
combat. If there are five Gehenna cards in play during your untap
phase, burn Mukhtar.

Massassi
Clan: Osebo (group 4)
Capacity: 9
Disciplines: AUS CEL POT QUI obf
Laibon: Massassi can enter combat with a ready vampire as a (D)
action. If that action is successful, she gets an optional maneuver in
the first round of the resulting combat.

They're all beefy with the exception of Rodrigo, but a Massassi or
Hektor combo could be workable with the right tech in place to save/
recover the pool. Hopefully there will be a handful of decent new
vampires to work into it, as well.
